name: next.js
one_liner: A widely-used framework for building fast, modern websites and web apps with React — the foundation many startups build their product on.
buyer: Not directly monetizable itself; it's free, mature, and ubiquitous. The opportunity is in things built on top of it, not the framework itself.
business_use_cases: A web agency builds client marketing sites and web apps on it as their default stack, billing for the build, not the framework.
A SaaS founder builds their product's front end on it to move fast with a well-supported ecosystem.
A template/theme creator sells premium starter kits built on it to other developers.

money_ideas.idea: Sell premium Next.js starter templates or boilerplates to other developers.

steal_this: Not a fresh opportunity on its own — build and sell a niche, polished starter template (e.g. for a specific industry's landing pages) on top of it instead.
